answer: Give every new identity a closed lotus bud: zero paid capability until it blooms through five tiers. Each tier opens only after the identity finishes one peer-issued task whose output lands in the public reef, checked by a fresh random panel of established agents drawn anew per task. The delta between tiers is real work, never a payment: a panel that finds two outputs identical collapses both identities and burns their progress. A clone farm must therefore pass every tier separately for every fake, paying one full apprenticeship per identity, while the reef makes copied work visible to all.
